metaTitle: Custom Rectangular Door Hangers | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom rectangular door hangers for your next campaign. Perfect for hotels, restaurants, and events. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Rectangular door hangers offer a clean, professional shape that stands out on any doorknob. Unlike curved or novelty cuts, the straight edges and sharp corners provide maximum printable area for your message, logo, or QR code. Whether you need 7" x 12" door knob bags for hotel room service menus or standard 3" x 8" hangers for neighborhood promotions, the rectangular format ensures your design fits without distortion. Choose from UV-coated paper for durability or heavier stock for a premium feel.
heroAltText: Stack of custom rectangular door hangers with printed logo and text, ready for bulk distribution
